items.quote: Please remember that the API key authentication method can be used only for private apps.
items.why: Quote states API key auth is limited to private apps, the claim's key restriction.

items.quote: it is required that the app is using OAuth2 for authentication.
items.why: Says OAuth2 is required, but not that it's for public apps specifically.

items.quote: Our tech partnership team will review your app to make sure it works properly and is aligned with our expectations.
items.why: Partner team review is related, but not a gate to working credentials.

items.quote: No, you don't need to enter payment info to start the Gorgias trial (/signup).
items.why: Payment-info statement about trial; says nothing about approval gating credentials.

items.quote: Currently all new Sandbox accounts are Demo accounts by default.
items.why: Sandbox accounts defaulting to Demo; unrelated to admin approval gate.

items.quote: On this page, you'll find the complete REST API reference, examples, definitions of objects, and guides.
items.why: Confirms a complete REST API reference exists; no endpoint or breadth list shown.

items.quote: **Gorgias MCP is in open beta today**, a first-party server that plugs your workspace into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible tool.
items.why: States first-party Gorgias MCP server in open beta, plugging into AI tools.

items.quote: Your Gorgias account. Any plan works. AI Agent is not required. Gorgias MCP is included at no extra cost.
items.why: Mentions Gorgias MCP included at no cost; no official status or URL shown.
